entities.name: Postmodernism
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: An intellectual movement questioning grand narratives, objective truth, and universal progress. Emerging from literary criticism and philosophy in the 1960s–1980s, it influenced architecture, art, literature, and social sciences worldwide.
